verdict.rationale: Runloop's docs state it provides official SDKs to interact with its API. Other pages name Python and TypeScript SDKs and describe Cursor rule files covering SDK use for devbox lifecycle, file operations, command execution, blueprints, snapshots and tunnels. Missing for 10: in-depth SDK reference or installation documentation in the evidence, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
